text: dsh-theme-eva 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 EVA 主题插件，可在初号机紫绿配色与二号机红橙配色之间实时切换。它注册 DSH 主题、设置项和侧栏及会话界面组件，并以字体路由提供内置字体。主要功能包括日常深色皮肤、入场启动动画、会话同步率显示和运行状态装饰。适合希望为 DSH 网页工作台更换 EVA 风格外观并查看会话状态的用户；无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-theme-eva brings two live-switchable EVA themes to the DSH web client. It registers theme and settings components, adds a dark skin, a boot cinematic, a context sync meter, and a running-status display. It fits users who want an EVA-style workspace; no API key or external service is required.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成 EVA 初号机或二号机配色。
能不能不重载页面就切换工作台主题？
让聊天页面打开时播放一个科幻风格的启动演出。
我想在会话标题附近看到上下文占用对应的同步率。
DSH 正在生成回复时，能显示已经运行了多久吗？
希望给侧栏和新会话页加上统一的主题背景与品牌标记。
I want to switch my DSH workspace between two Evangelion inspired color schemes live.
Can I see a cinematic boot sequence and a context-based sync meter in the web client?
dsh-theme-eva 的功能「双主题切换」：提供初号机与二号机两套配色主题。用户在 EVA 设置中选择机体后，客户端切换对应主题并保存选择。
dsh-theme-eva 的功能「EVA 外观」：将 DSH 网页界面的颜色变量、侧栏、会话背景和品牌标记套用所选机体的深色风格。主题关闭后会恢复原有主题偏好。
dsh-theme-eva 的功能「同步率显示」：在会话标题工具区显示上下文余量换算出的同步率，并按低于 30% 或 10% 的阈值改变提示颜色。
dsh-theme-eva 的功能「运行计时装饰」：在 DSH 原生运行状态旁显示当前开放轮次的计时与信号线；结束或隐藏原生状态后会移除装饰。

dsh-theme-eva README · dsh-theme-eva：EVA themes for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): **Unit-02 (弐号机)** and **Unit-01 (初号机)**, switchable live.

| Unit | Armour | Markings | Sync stop |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 02 弐号機 · PRODUCTION MODEL | red `#d8262e` | orange `#f06a22` | 99.2% |
| 01 初号機 · TEST TYPE | purple `#8d4dde` | lime `#a0da3b` | 99.6% |

dsh-theme-eva README · dsh-theme-eva：- **Entry cinematic.** Every time the page opens: start gate → cel-shaded (toon + ink outline) entry plug inserted into the spine socket in hard-cut shots → an x-ray scope of the plug sinking through the lock rings → LCL floods the cabin and is electrified → hard cuts to command-room monitor screens (main power distribution, a circuit matrix opening lines 0001–1405, an anatomical nerve-connection schematic lighting up limb by limb, brain-region vital traces for the A10 link, a three-computer vote) between Mincho intertitle cards → a harmonics scope where the pilot and unit waves (hex-mesh tubes) close in as the sync ratio climbs to the unit's stop (99.2% / 99.6%) and waits for the pilot to confirm → 100% → 「弐号機 起動」 / 「初号機 起動」 title card → workbench. Everything is drawn in code (three.js + 2D canvas) and loaded only while it plays. To skip at any time, **hold Esc** (or press and hold the skip button) for about 1.2 s — a progress bar fills while you hold and drains if you let go early.
- **Sync plate.** A small plate in the session header: sync ratio = 100% − context window occupancy, taken from the session's real context pressure. Below 30% it tu

dsh-theme-eva README · dsh-theme-eva：Settings live in **Settings → General → EVA 接入 / EVA Link**: theme, **unit (搭乘机体: 初号机 / 弐号机)**, cinematic, voice and sound, running indicator and sync plate can each be turned off, and there is a **Replay** button. The sidebar footer has a **重新接入 / Re-link** button too.

While the theme is on, the appearance is locked to dark (EVA has no light mode). Turning it off restores your own light/dark/system setting.
dsh-theme-eva README · dsh-theme-eva：If the system setting **Reduce motion** is on, the 3D cinematic is replaced by a 2-second static title card, with no gates and no running indicator animation.
dsh-theme-eva README · Screenshots：Real 1920×1080 captures of the theme's code-rendered startup cinematic (not workbench screenshots or mockups).

dsh-theme-eva README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/nerv-base/dsh-theme-eva.git
cd dsh-theme-eva
npm install
npm run build

Then, from a DSH session, ask the agent to install the bundle at the absolute path of this directory (plugin manager `install_bundle`), or install it from the plugin market once it is published. Reload the window after installing.

dsh-theme-eva README · Develop：| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run build` | Bundle `src/` into `lib/client.js` (main) and `lib/client.cinema.js` (lazy cinematic chunk). `-- --dev` skips minification, `-- --watch` rebuilds on change. |
| `npm test` | Run the unit-data, native-status adapter and mounted React lifecycle regression tests. |
| `npm run fonts` | Re-subset the fonts from the full OTF/TTF sources (`EVA_FONT_SRC`, default `/tmp/evafonts`) to the characters used in `src/`. Run after changing any Japanese copy. |
| `npm run voice` | Render missing announcer clips with edge-tts; `-- --force` re-renders all. Needs `python3 -m pip install --user edge-tts`. |
dsh-theme-eva README · Develop：`scripts/harness/cinema.html` runs the cinematic on its own: serve the repository root with any static server and open `/scripts/harness/cinema.html`.

dsh-theme-eva README · Develop：Unit-specific values (palette roles, surfaces, colour ramps, code tokens, number, pilot callsign, every cinematic line and its spoken reading) live in `src/shared/units.js`. Units share one data shape (`tests/units.test.mjs` checks it); art is drawn once in template colours and recoloured per unit, and voice clips common to all units are `assets/voice/shared-*.mp3`. Adding a unit = one entry in `UNITS`, its `backdrop-right-NN.svg` / `mark-NN.svg` (`scripts/gen-backdrop.py`), its confirm/title clips (`npm run voice`), and the id in the `unit` union of `lib/index.js`.
dsh-theme-eva README · Develop：`scripts/harness/cinema.html?unit=01` previews another unit's cinematic.

dsh-theme-eva README · Switching units：The selected unit is the durable `unit` field (`"01"` | `"02"`, default `"02"`) of the `theme-eva` settings section, so the settings UI, `configForms.get("theme-eva").set("unit", "01")` or a settings-document edit all switch it. While the page is open the plugin also publishes a handle:

dsh-theme-eva README · Switching units：```js
globalThis.dshThemeEva.units            // [{ id: "02", themeId: "eva-02", label, palette, … }, { id: "01", … }]
globalThis.dshThemeEva.getUnit()        // the unit showing now, or undefined while the theme is off
await globalThis.dshThemeEva.setUnit("01") // persist + switch (false if the Host refused)
await globalThis.dshThemeEva.setEnabled(false)

dsh-theme-eva README · Switching units：Each unit registers its own DSH theme (`eva-01` / `eva-02`); a switch activates the new theme before retracting the old one, so there is no flash of the stock palette. The skin and component styles read `--eva-accent`, `--eva-marking`, `--eva-green`, … custom properties, which other plugins can use too (`body[data-eva-theme]` holds the unit id).

Layout:

dsh-theme-eva README · Switching units：```
lib/index.js            Host half: preferences (Config) + allowlisted asset route /eva-theme-assets
src/client/             Browser half: theme tokens, skin CSS, settings row, brand seats, sync meter, overlay
src/cinema/             Lazy chunk: three.js scene, HUD, WebAudio sound design, announcer
src/shared/units.js     Per-unit configuration
